verdict.rationale: Supermemory publishes an API reference section listing official TypeScript and Python clients, and its docs include copyable code snippets such as client.add and client.search calls. Nothing shows that the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in the browser, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable in-browser examples, a published OpenAPI spec, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Official clients wrap this API: TypeScript: npm install supermemory Python: pip install supermemory
await client.add({ content: "The user loves Paris.", containerTag: "user_123" });
const results = await client.search({ q: "where does Alex work?", containerTag: "user_123", include: { relatedMemories: true }, });
